Results.ReviewText: I’ve used it for over one year.  It’s easily moved.  I live in a condo and keep it hidden when not using it.  You can cook 6 large flat store bought hamburgers with no problems.  It’s not for real large families, but it’s ideal for families of four.  It heats evenly and is easy to clean if you clean it each time you use it. I use Grill Sheet Mats that I purchase at Walmart.  It keeps the grill grates from getting too greasy and allows for easy clean up.  They don’t change the way the meat cooks.  Only use one Grill Sheet Mat at a time as 2 sheets are too many for a small grill as it will put out the flame.

Results.ReviewText: I got the q1200 grill and stand, and realized I may have gotten too small of a grill. I worried about the size and 8000 btu vs a similar priced q2000 with 100 more cubic inches and 12000 btu’s. After cooking for a few people a couple times, in certain this grill is fine. It’s super capable and yes the space would have been nice (q2000) but this is super portable. Can’t wait to bring to the beach!

ClientResponses.Response:
Hello. We are sorry to hear that you are not satisfied with your grill. It's not unusual for a Q model to run hotter because of the smaller size.
To alleviate this we would recommend preheating the grill with the control knob set to Low. You can also baffle the heat with a roasting rack or pan, and please make sure to keep the cookbox clean since grease and debris will generate extra heat. We hope you will find these tips helpful. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills
